verdict.rationale: There is no first-party documentation of an in-app chat or messaging feature. The only support is indirect: a community user reports their team used Asana itself for remote team communication instead of Slack (asana-comm-5), and the Slack integration mentions task comments living in Asana (asana-intdir-6). That points to comment-based communication on work items rather than real-time chat. Integrations with Slack and Teams pull communication out to other tools and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented native team chat/messaging inside Asana, real-time conversation features, first-party docs describing in-tool communication, independent hands-on corroboration.
